property_summary: For any reachable initialized state with a live LogFile and any caller balance B and withdraw amount A where A <= B and B >= MinSum, a successful Collect leaves balances[caller] == B - A (so the post-balance plus A equals the pre-balance), whereas the mutant leaves balances[caller] == B + A, violating balance(actor) == B - A after a successful Collect.
change_summary: Replace the subtraction update `balances[msg.sender] - _am` with `balances[msg.sender] + _am`, so a successful Collect increases the recorded balance instead of decreasing it.
